name: Beginner Big Cubes Ohio 2025
information:
This competition takes place on a **Friday Evening** and features only big cubes (4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, and 7x7x7 Cube), and is for beginners or those who normally aren't able to compete in these cubes at other competitions. However, this competition might not be recommended for first-time competitors as it does not include the normal 3x3x3 Cube. For those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)
Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest or carpooling as spectator seating and parking spaces will be limited.

All competitors will be expected to help out in the group they are not competing in.
